newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel opens roadshow for $200 mln Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Israel opens roadshow for $200 mln Eurobond issue.

text.p: - Israeli Treasury officials leave on Monday for a roadshow in Europe and Japan to prepare the way for the country's $200 million debut Eurobond offering, the Treasury said on Sunday.

Director-General David Brodet, Counsel-General Shai Talmon and Deputy Accountant-General Avi Elkind will meet investors in Frankfurt, London and Tokyo in advance of the offering, slated for early December.
The $200 million issue is the first planned for the next three years, during which time Israel expects to raise a total of $750 million.
In September, Israel signed an agreement with a syndicate of banks led by Merrill Lynch to make the offerings.

Israel has permission to raise up to $10 billion over five years ending in 1998 with U.S. guarantees. The Eurobond issue will mark its second issue without American backing after a $250 million Yankee bond issue made at the end of 1995.
